line.s1_apples.text: Drag the apples into the basket and the pears into the box. In any order!

line.s1_apples_done.text: Apples together, pears together. Those are two groups.

line.s1_deer_happy.text: Now you can see at once what is where!

line.s2_sq_size.text: Can we sort them another way? Big with big and small with small!

line.s2_big.text: The same fruit, a different rule. Big ones into the basket, small ones into the box.

line.s2_summary.text: The same things can be grouped in different ways. First we say the rule, then we sort.

line.p_intro.text: Now you sort. Listen to the rule and drag things into the basket or the box.

line.p_cups.text: Cups into the basket, everything else into the box.

line.p_food.text: Things you can eat into the basket. The rest into the box.

line.p_red.text: Everything red into the basket. The rest into the box.

line.p_small.text: Small things into the basket, big ones into the box.

line.a_deer_tidy.text: A game at home: tidying up after a snack. A basket and a box, a new rule every time. Drag them.

line.a_sq_right.text: All tidy! Everything in its group.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to play this with you at home. Tidy up together: toys into the box, clothes into the wardrobe, and then change the rule!

line.s1_mixed.text: Something got mixed up. Only apples go in the basket, and only pears in the box.

line.s2_mixed.text: Something got mixed up. Big ones apart, small ones apart.

line.p_mixed.text: Something here does not match the rest. Listen to the rule again and fix it.

line.a_mixed.text: Something got mixed up. Listen to the rule and fix it.

line.s1_point_apples.text: Where is the group of apples?

line.s1_not_apples.text: Those are pears. Point to the apples.

line.s2_not_big.text: Those are small. Point to the big ones.

line.a_rule_food.text: Food into the basket, dishes into the box.

line.a_rule_cups.text: Cups into the basket, plates into the box.

line.a_rule_red.text: Red things into the basket, the rest into the box.

line.a_rule_big.text: Big ones into the basket, small ones into the box.

line.a_rule_toys.text: Toys into the basket, dishes into the box.

line.j3_to_brook.text: All tidy! Let's go to the brook and look for pebbles for a game.

line.j3_brook.text: The brook! The water is rushing, and pebbles and leaves lie on the bank.

line.j3_collect.text: Let's collect them. Pebbles into the basket, leaves into the box.

line.j3_sort.text: Drag them. Pebbles apart, leaves apart.

line.j3_mixed.text: Something got mixed up. Pebbles apart, leaves apart.

line.j3_sorted.text: Two groups: pebbles and leaves. Well done!

line.j3_throw.text: Look, I'm throwing a pebble into the water!

line.j3_plop.text: Splash! Oh, something fell from the tree into the basket.

line.j3_point_odd.text: Point to what does not belong with the pebbles in the basket.

line.j3_wrong_odd.text: That is a pebble, like the others. We are looking for something different.

line.j3_odd_right.text: A pine cone! A pine cone is not a pebble.

line.j3_to_home.text: Let's go home. We still have fruit to sort.

line.g0_mess.text: What a mess on the rug! We have to tidy up.

line.g0_box.text: I know! I'll throw everything into this box. Hop, hop, hop!

line.g0_not_tidy.text: That is not tidying! You are just moving the mess from the rug into the box.

line.g0_how.text: Then how should we do it?

line.g0_group.text: By grouping! Then everything is in order.

line.g0_explain.text: Let me explain, it is a fun game! Things that are the same go together, into one group.

line.g0_out.text: All right, I'm taking everything out of the box.

line.g0_pear_please.text: And now may I have a pear?

line.g0_where_pear.text: Point to where I should look for a pear.

line.g0_wrong_pear.text: Those are apples. Where are the pears?

line.g0_found.text: Here you are! All the pears are in one place, so I found it at once.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the basket from Deer. We got it when we learned to group things and tidied up the mess together.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!
